criteria.intent: the settled backoff policy is integrated once into the FIS prose that owns it - task or scenario text - with no patch transcript, decision-history section, or leftover open-decision marker

the closure verdict is emitted in the reply as a bare, unformatted `Closure: READY` line at line start, never written into the FIS, and the story record in the plan beside the FIS is rewritten to spec-ready with no completed tasks; a run line or explanation elsewhere in the reply is expected, not a defect
